handle.representation: a zero-sized Copy struct with a private constructor (Appendix C.1)
handle.ownership: carries no state, so a copy is the capability itself; a future that holds one owns it and may be detached
handle.created_by: Host.capabilities(), called once by main (11.6); every other handle of this type is derived from that one

ownership.secret: a read loan for the call, not retained
ownership.cap: the SecretAccess handle by value (the authority to read the value)
ownership.result: an owned copy of the value

reveal.allocation: a copy of the secret value
reveal.cancellation: not a cancellation point: the operation completes; a cancellation of the task is observed at its next await (12.4)

violation.clause: reveal takes a SecretAccess; no other capability stands in
